name: sticker_reply
description: Send a WhatsApp sticker from your personal sticker pack — stickers you've previously sent to OADSON. Use 'send' to reply with a sticker (pick the most contextually appropriate one, or random if nothing fits). Use 'list' to see what's in the pack. OADSON can decide on its own to reply with a sticker instead of text when the moment calls for it — e.g. a funny sticker after a joke, a heart sticker after a warm message. Gemini decides whether to send a sticker or text based on context — if a sticker fits better, use this skill instead of plain text.

action.description: 'send' picks and sends a sticker. 'list' returns all available stickers.

emoji_hint.description: Optional. Emoji or mood keyword to help pick the right sticker (e.g. '😂', 'funny', 'sad', 'heart'). If not provided, picks the most contextually appropriate or a random one.

sticker_id.description: Optional. Send a specific sticker by its ID (from 'list'). Takes priority over emoji_hint.
